posts.title: Is CSS the future of design data?
posts.description: Design tokens solve complex problems, and the community behind them has done thoughtful work. But the surfaces a design system has to support are growing in dimension, and as new features reach Baseline, CSS has become a better home for design data than tokens.

posts.title: On writing the custom elements section for Modern Web Guidance
posts.description: Nolan Lawson called the web components section I wrote for Chrome's Modern Web Guidance "discouraging at times," and he has a point about the tone. Here's why I leaned native-first, and where Nolan and I land in the same place.

posts.title: How Firefox renders web components
posts.description: How Firefox turns a custom element into pixels, traced through Gecko's own source, from the registry to the reactions stack to the flattened tree Stylo styles.
